candidacy: pooled delta < 0 (directional; NOT a numeric threshold)

complexity_preference.rule: blend preferred; stacker advances only on materially stronger AND robust evidence
complexity_preference.stacker_handicap: D1 unevaluable + D2/D3 instability weigh against

neighbor_robustness.basin: both neighbors pooled-negative with same fold-sign pattern; penalize isolated/edge/exact-precision optima

probability_quality_criteria.brier_ece: pooled deltas must not be materially positive
probability_quality_criteria.rule: LL gain via worse Brier/ECE -> REJECT_PROBABILITY_QUALITY

stage_criteria.cells: 9 fold x stage cells; report count negative; unanimity is strong supporting evidence

temporal_criteria.fold_support: count of D1/D2/D3 folds with delta < 0; >=2 required for ROBUST consideration
temporal_criteria.instability: gain concentrated in one fold while others regress -> REJECT_TEMPORAL_INSTABILITY

tie_handling: indistinguishable neighbors -> more conservative (smaller w; less departure from Logistic)
